text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mm-mm! I'm telling ya, these taiyaki are
the best!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Y'know the famous taiyaki shop in the
shopping
district? They give them to me
for free so I can
keep racing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A-and, well... they're so good that I go
back for
more... Now I've put on a few
pounds...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But I'll lose the weight with a bit of
running! And
the nice people in the
shopping district will be
happy to see
me run too! So for now... I'm gonna
dig
right in! ♪
